svg.text: Rank = one GPU taking part in the job. Same server = NVLink between the GPUs. Same network block = servers that sit close together on the data-center

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: network (this page's plain word). No source read says how far apart any split may sit.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A collective is one operation that all ranks do together. All-reduce adds the values of all ranks and gives every rank the sum. All-gather gives every

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rank the pieces of all ranks. Reduce-scatter adds the values and each rank keeps one piece of the sum.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Forward pass = the model computes its output for a batch. Backward pass = it computes the gradients. Gradient = a number that says how to change one

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: parameter. Microbatch = one of the smaller pieces a batch is split into (Megatron-LM paper).

svg.text: Sources: PyTorch FSDP tutorial, PyTorch DeviceMesh recipe, Megatron-LM paper (arXiv 2104.04473). The step by step of DDP and FSDP is in Appendix B.
